name: Cursor
description: Cursor is an AI-assisted coding product built by Anysphere, Inc., whose official terms list an address in San Francisco, California. Its mission is to accelerate software development by integrating state-of-the-art language models into a developer-first IDE experience for editing, navigation, refactoring and agentic code generation.
